title: Irrigation Member Terms: Spreading a Large Annual Minimum Adjustment at Restore (Electric Service by Rate Schedule)
content:
**Spread provision.** When an idle Electric Service by Rate Schedule account is restored, part of a large annual minimum adjustment may be held back from the restore payment and left to later bills. The provision reads the latest annual minimum adjustment line on the service account and how long the account has been connected.

| Latest annual minimum adjustment line | Connected | Held back from the restore payment |
|---|---|---|
| $300.00 or more | Less than 36 whole months before the current date | 0.6667 (66.67 percent) of the adjustment, rounded to the cent |
| $300.00 or more | 36 whole months or more before the current date | 0.50 (half) of the adjustment, rounded to the cent |
| Below $300.00, or no such line | Any | Nothing |

The part held back stays on the account for later bills; it is taken off the restore payment before that payment is rounded and held at no less than zero.

### Hypothetical cases

| Latest adjustment line | Connected | Held back |
|---|---|---|
| $713.50 | 20 whole months | $475.68 |
| $713.50 | 64 whole months | $356.75 |
| $300.00 | 64 whole months | $150.00 |
| $299.99 | 20 whole months | Nothing |
